items.name: Rapier
items.description: You can use the Weapon Finesse feat to apply your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to attack rolls with a rapier sized for you, even though it isn't a light weapon. You can't wield a rapier in two hands in order to apply 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier to its damage.

items.name: Tempest Veil
items.description:
This salt-crusted deep-blue cloak, adorned with faded embroidery of crashing waves and jagged lightning bolts, once belonged to the ill-fated pirate-adventurer Captain Jorren "Squall" Veyne. He sought lost knowledge in the depths of the Shackles but met his end beneath the unyielding fists of a golem guardian before he could reach the treasure halls beyond.
The Stormcaller's Shroud grants its wearer a +2 resistance bonus on all saving throws and crackles with protective energy against the storms

items.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie
items.description: The chocolate chip cookie is a sweet baked treat that is recognized by its buttery flavor and the inclusion of chocolate chips, which can be dark, milk, or white chocolate depending on personal preference. It's a classic favorite for people of all ages, not just young folk, and is often enjoyed with a cold glass of milk or a warm cup of coffee. items.name: Tools, Thieves' (Masterwork)
items.description:
This kit contains lockpicks and other tools you need to use the Disable Device skill. Without these tools, you must use improvised tools, and you take a -2 circumstance penalty on Disable Device checks.

This kit contains extra tools and tools of better make, which grant a +2 circumstance bonus on Disable Device checks.

items.name: .308 762x51mm Nosler Cartridge
items.description: 7.62x51mm Nosler cartridge. The bullet is loaded with two separate lead cores with a solid partition between them. The front part is torn quickly, delivering great energy. The base remains intact and provides deep penetration, even when hitting bones.

items.description:

Effect: Grants a +2 competence bonus on Knowledge (local / history) checks regarding pirate politics and Free Captain rivalries.Lore: Compiled by an anonymous chronicler, this book is full of firsthand accounts of betrayals, duels, and secret dealings among the Shackles’ pirate elite.

items.description:
A famous recipe from Savage Sustenance, these spicy and flavorful tacos will surprise & delight any diners!
Enjoyer of these tacos is granted the Caimon Taco Buff, which grants +20 movement on a charge attack, a 20 swim speed and the ability to charge through water, and the ability to hold one's breath for 30 minutes.

items.name: Mulled Wine
items.description: Mulled wine becomes a staple drink as the colder seasons begin. The wine is boiled and then infused with sugar, black pepper, cinnamon, cloves, and orange peels. Served hot, it is rumored to cure the common cold, though it is primarily enjoyed for its warming effect.

items.name: Scroll of Mage Armor
items.description:
An invisible but tangible field of force surrounds the subject of a mage armor spell, providing a +4 armor bonus to AC.
Unlike mundane armor, mage armor entails no armor check penalty, arcane spell failure chance, or speed reduction. Since mage armor is made of force, incorporeal creatures can't bypass it the way they do normal armor.

items.name: The Dainty
items.description:
The barrel of this weapon has been enchanted for +1 attack and damage, and an additional, well hidden effect. When fired at a target that is flatfooted or unaware of the weapon, it receives +2 to hit.
The Dainty was once the prized possession of Captain Seraphine "Silk" Barrow, a renowned pirate known for her sharp tongue, impeccable taste, and deadly aim. Unlike most pirates, Captain Barrow enjoyed the finer things in life and commissioned this elegant pistol from an artisan gunsmith in Sargava
